title: $100m boost for Quantinuum’s US scale-up
key_facts: Quantinuum finalised $100m federal funding via the US Commerce Department's CHIPS R&D Office
Money comes through the CHIPS and Science Act
Follows a letter of intent announced in May
Quantinuum is the only trapped-ion company awarded CHIPS R&D funding
Adds onshore partners GlobalFoundries and Monarch Quantum
Monarch to make lasers and optical parts; GlobalFoundries to make ion traps on 300mm wafers
quote_evidence: Quantinuum, which was the only company with a trapped-ion based architecture to be awarded CHIPS R&D funding
It follows a letter of intent announced in May.
why_it_matters_hint: Federal money to build US supply chain for trapped-ion quantum computers.
event_date: finalised now; letter of intent May 2026
notes: Funding follows a May letter of intent (month only given in the article); company and partner quotes are promotional.
